title: feat(app-shell,components): on a phone the record is always a page, with a compact header, a bottom action bar and related records pushed as pages
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgT93xhnhe2yKWX7YPc

Fixes #27058

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/components` gains `PageHeaderPhoneContext` (+ type `PageHeaderPhoneFace`) and an optional `PageHeaderActionsProps.face`; `MobileViewSwitcherContext` is not on the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry, so its retirement narrows nothing.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：手机上（窗口宽度小于 768）记录永远是整页：列表点一行直接进记录页，不再弹全屏抽屉或分屏；列表的视图切换器「全部线索 ▾ · 5」挪到列表工具栏首位，顶部应用栏不再画第二个视图下拉；记录页顶栏只剩一个返回和计数 ↓ ↑，顶层页写「‹ 对象列表」，推入的下一层写父记录名（「‹ Acme Corp」）；头部用对象声明的前两个文本高亮做副标题，后面最多 4 个高亮；业务操作放进页面底部的操作栏（主操作、一个次操作、⋯）；关联行和查找值整页推入，顶栏下有路径行「线索 Marie Curie › 客户」，‹ 返回上一层并回到原来的滚动位置。
- **为什么改**：#27058（画布 60 的 RecordMobile 板）：手机是 v4 记录页压到 390 px，再加三件只有手机才有的事：记录永远是整页、业务操作在底栏、关联记录整页推入带路径行。
- **风险与回滚**：只动 ui 包（`app-shell`、`components`），不碰 spec、不碰服务端；768 px 及以上一切照旧（每个新测试都带桌面对照）。`components` 新增一个宿主插槽和一个可选 prop，是 widening；退役的 `MobileViewSwitcherContext` 从未在包入口导出。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` 的 `barQueue`（底栏按钮怎么排、编辑何时进 ⋯）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 `phoneBack` / `phonePathRow` 和 `data-record-action-bar` 容器；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` 的 `phone` 分支（`?recordId=` 换成整页）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-phone-bar-27058.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.phoneRecordPage-27058.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/recordPagePush-27058.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.phoneNoViewDropdown-27058.test.tsx`，预期 5 个文件 31 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Below 768 px (the `useIsMobile` breakpoint, read synchronously by the new `hooks/usePhoneViewport.ts`, because what it decides is mounted, not styled) the console is on a phone. What follows is the v4 record page (#27524) in a container under 760 px plus the three things only a phone adds. No metadata key, no reader preference, no `packages/spec` file.

### Target 1: the record is always a page

- `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` answers the spec's own rule on a phone: `deriveRecordSurface(objectDef, { viewport: 'mobile' })` → `page`. A row tap navigates to the record route with the list as its `from` (and the shown rows as its ↓ ↑ set, the #27524 hand-off).
- `ObjectView.tsx` mounts no `ObjectViewRecordOverlay` on a phone (no split pane, no drawer, no maximize), and hands the list no `recordOpen`, so the Display menu has no Open records section and a stored split / drawer preference draws nothing.
- A `?recordId=` URL (a shared pane link) is replaced, not pushed, by the record page.
- `console/AppContent.tsx`: a record created from the list opens with the same surface rule (`viewport: 'mobile'` on a phone).

### Target 2: one view switcher

- Below `sm` (the header's own breakpoint, `useViewTabsFit`) the page header is not drawn, so the #27594 title switcher is handed to the list as `phoneTitle`: it leads the list's toolbar row (`ListView`'s existing `toolbarLeading` slot) beside the filter / sort / display icons, or heads a chart face. The header then gets no switcher, so there is exactly one.
- The list's own view-type switcher (`showViewSwitcher`, the Display menu's Layout row) is off there.
- `AppHeader` draws the page's name and no view dropdown; `MobileViewSwitcherContext.tsx` is deleted, with its provider in `ConsoleLayout.tsx` and its registration in `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`.

### Target 3: the top bar

`RecordDetailView`'s page bar on a phone is `RecordTopBar` with one way back on the left and the counter + ↓ ↑ on the right when the page knows its rows. No ⊟ (the stack has no right column) and no ⤡ (no drawer to collapse to). On a top-level page the way back reads 「‹ OBJECT_PLURAL」 and returns to the list the page came from, else the object's list. On a page one level down it is named by where it returns (Target 8, see Acceptance notes): the parent record's title from the `?from=` trail (「‹ Acme Corp」), or its short id when the trail carries none; it links to the trail's parent, or goes back in the history on a page pushed in this session.

### Target 4: the header

For a default (synthesized) page, `views/recordPhoneHeader.ts` takes the subtitle from the first two declared `highlightFields` whose type is `text`, joined by 「 · 」 from the values the reader can see, and keeps at most four highlights after them (`PHONE_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX`). The subtitle reaches `page:header` through the host slot below and is drawn only when the header declares no `subtitle` of its own. An object that declares no highlights gets the derived strip and no subtitle; an authored page draws its own header.

### Target 7: the bottom action bar

- `@object-ui/components` gains `PageHeaderPhoneContext` (`renderers/layout/page-header-phone-context.ts`, beside `PageHeaderTrailingContext`): a host slot, never metadata. The record page provides it on a phone with its bar element and the subtitle.
- Under it `PageHeaderRenderer` draws no action row: the same `PageHeaderActions` resolver renders in its new `face: 'bar'` and is portaled (`createPortal`) into the host's bar, so the actions keep the record's contexts. Nothing is drawn until the bar element exists.
- The bar face holds the primary action, one more and the `⋯` (`PHONE_ACTION_BAR_BUTTONS = 2`; a page's declared `mobileMaxVisible` still wins). Each button shares the bar's width; the host's Delete stays in the `⋯`'s destructive band.
- The bar is the page column's last flex row (`border-t`, `pb-[max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom),0.75rem)]`), under the scroller, so the body ends where the bar starts. There is no FAB on a record page (the FAB is the list's).

### Target 8: one level down

- `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.openRecord` on a phone navigates to the record route with the `?from=` trail extended (as before) and the history state `recordPagePushState` builds (`views/recordPagePush.ts`): the parent page as `from`, the related list's rows as `from.siblings`, and a `recordPagePushed` marker. No drawer stack is mounted on a phone (`RecordDetailView` returns its page tree without `RecordPageDrawerHost`).
- A path row under the top bar draws the trail (「线索 Marie Curie › 客户 Acme Corp › 商机」), each ancestor a link; on a pushed page the parent entry and 「‹ Acme Corp」 go back in the history (`navigate(-1)`).
- `useRecordPageScrollMemory` remembers the page scroller's position per history entry and restores it when the reader comes back by Back / Forward, retrying while the panels load, for up to 3 s, until the reader touches the scroller.

### Unchanged

768 px and up; the pane's split / overlay / maximize mechanics (#27545); `navigation-overlay.tsx` and `recordDrawerStack.tsx` (not mounted on a phone, not edited); the record page's layout rule (the stack below 760 px, the tab row's own width count, the enlarged tab's card rows: all already read the page's own width and needed no change); `plugin-list` (its `toolbarLeading` and `recordOpen` props already existed).

### File surface beyond the claim amendment 6548379901

- The phone context lives at `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page-header-phone-context.ts`, beside `page-header-trailing-context.ts`, not under `custom/` as the amendment spelled it.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewTabLabel.ts` and one comment in `ObjectView.tsx`: comment-only lines that named the retired mobile switcher.
- Tests in `ui/packages/plugin-detail` and `ui/packages/plugin-grid` (pins only, see Tests).
- Not needed and not touched: `objectViewRecordLinks.ts`, `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`, `RecordPageColumns.tsx`, `synth/recordPageColumns.ts`, `RecordTabRow.tsx`, `RelatedList.tsx`, `record-top-bar.tsx`, the i18n packs (no key added; the bar reuses `detail.goBack`, `common.breadcrumb` and the header's own keys).

**The two points the seat asked to see stated:**

- **The app bar (`AppHeader`) is kept on the phone record page.** The board's frame starts at the record's top bar, but on a phone `AppHeader` is the only door to the app menu (the sidebar trigger), search, notifications and the account menu, on every route, the record page included. The card names no other place for them, so retiring the bar on record routes would leave a reader on a record page with no way to another app or to search. What this PR removes from the bar is only the second view dropdown (Target 2). If the preview gate wants the record page without it, that is a separate decision about where those four doors go on a phone.
- **Edit and the bar's second slot.** In the bar face the host's Edit is one of the record's actions: it queues after the page's own actions (`barQueue`: the primary, then the authored actions in their order, then the host's non-destructive buttons). So a page that declares ONE action shows [that action][编辑][⋯] (shot 02, Convert Lead); a page that declares a second action shows [primary][second][⋯] and 编辑 is the first host entry in the `⋯`, after the page's own folded actions (pinned in `page-header-phone-bar-27058` and `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058`); a page that declares none shows [编辑][⋯] (shot 10). On the desktop row nothing changes: the host's buttons stay inline beside the authored ones.

**Readings and deviations** (the first three agreed with the seat before the build):

- **No avatar initials** in the phone header (hotcrm#1199, ruling A). An object with a declared picture field still shows its picture through the header's existing chip.
- **The subtitle** comes only from declared text `highlightFields` on a default page; no declared list means no subtitle (app-crm declares none: shots 02 and 13).
- **The bar is a flex row** at the foot of the page column, not `position: fixed` with a `scroll-pb`. It stays visible while the body scrolls (shot 03, bar box in `run.log` for every record shot), and the body ends where the bar starts, which is what the `scroll-pb` was for.
- **The ‹ label: Target 3 governs the top level, Target 8 names the next level** (the seat's reading). Target 3's 「‹ OBJECT_PLURAL」 is the way back of a top-level page, which returns to the object's list. Target 8 says a page one level down returns to its parent record, so its 「‹」 is named by that return target: the parent's title from the `?from=` trail (「‹ Acme Corp」, as the board's pushed frame reads), else its short id. A pushed page and a `?from=` page opened from a link read the same; back on the parent, its own 「‹」 reads the object plural again. Both texts are pinned in one case of `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058`.
- **The card's lead → task shots.** app-crm has no task object, so the push is shown as lead → account (a lookup) → opportunity (a related row), and the 任务 tab as the account's 活动列表 tab.
- **640–767 px** (a large phone in landscape, a small tablet): the record is a page (below 768), and the page header with its title switcher is drawn (from `sm`, 640), as at that width before.
- **Not built here:** the counter's group scope, as in #27524 ④ (`ListView` reports rows only for the ungrouped grid).
